 Live Results: Michigan Senate midterm election
 Politics 
 Nov 3, 2026 9:30 AM EST
 WATCH LIVE: Election night 2026 PBS News special coverage 
 Michigan Sen. Gary Peters' retirement after serving two terms in the Senate leaves the only open Democratic seat in a state President Donald Trump won in 2024.
 Democrat Abdul El-Sayed, a former Wayne County health director, narrowly won his party's August primary over Rep. Haley Stevens on a progressive platform, with backing from the United Auto Workers labor union.
 Stand with free and independent journalism. Join Press Pass from PBS News 
 Republican Mike Rogers, a former seven-term congressman and House Intelligence Committee chair, narrowly lost the 2024 Senate race to Elissa Slotkin. He has President Donald Trump's backing and establishment Republican support.
 On Sunday, Stevens crossed party lines to endorse Rogers in a move that stunned the state's Democratic leaders.
 -- Matt Loffman
